contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ [...]TINI-ANVS P F AVG

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD364-375. Mint is Siscia, AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, dragging captive and holding standard. See LRBC p.73, nos.1396-1399. Obverse shows diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]TINI-ANVS P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: [F]R/-A//.SISC. . Die axis is…
